correctness.rationale: Starting from the source’s exact positive-band factorization, writing x=m pi+y and u=tan(|y|/2) reduces the criterion to (u-r_m)(1-r_m u)>=0 with r_m=A_m/x and A_m=ell cot(pi t_m/4). Since m t_m->tau, r_m converges uniformly on the fixed-width cell to r=4ell/(pi^2 tau). Thus the limiting admitted momenta are |y|>=2 arctan(min{r,r^{-1}}); dominated convergence gives the momentum fraction and x/(m pi)->1 uniformly transfers it to energy measure. The isolated Dirichlet point is null. A fresh direct midpoint evaluation of the original source inequality at m=400 matched the limit to below 10^-6 away from the pinch and showed the expected O(1/m) residual fraction at the pinch.

final_claim: For the Kirchhoff-endpoint interpolating square quantum graph and any t_m with m t_m -> tau>0, the normalized Lebesgue spectral fraction in the m-th Dirichlet-centered energy cell converges to F_ell(tau)=1-(4/pi) arctan(min{r,r^{-1}}), r=4ell/(pi^2 tau), with a unique zero at tau=4ell/pi^2 and limit one at both scaling extremes.
